children: HC Wainwright & Co. reiterated their Buy rating on Joby Aviation's stock with a price target of $18.00.
The price target implies an upside of 194.1% from the Sep 18 close of $6.12.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Analysts project Joby Aviation's revenues to soar from $122 million in 2026 to $14.2 billion by 2036, indicating a robust ten-year compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 61%. This anticipated growth signals a promising future for the company as it scales its operations in the eVTOL market.

: Joby is expected to see its gross margins increase significantly, from an estimated 25% in 2026 to around 50% by 2035. This improvement suggests that the company is on track to enhance profitability as it scales, making it an attractive investment opportunity.
